recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, multimedia composition featuring a group of young adults standing in a futuristic urban tunnel, framed by a distressed rectangular border and topped with heavy, fragmented block lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: The central group is framed within a secondary internal border to create depth.
The high-contrast red jacket acts as a focal point against a cool blue-toned background.
The aggressive, broken typography at the top balances the grounded weight of the figures below.
A horizontal 'glitch' or scan-line effect cuts through the primary title text.
coreInvariants: Internal framing device with rough edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of six figures occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, black, distressed title text at the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold title down to the central group, then following the perspective lines of the tunnel into the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and the very bottom edge provide breathing room for the heavy central elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated steel blue and icy white (background and environment)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright background and dark silhouettes, with low saturation except for the red accent.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a cold, industrial spectrum

letterConstructionRules: Letters are constructed as heavy black blocks
A horizontal slice or 'tear' runs through the middle of the glyphs
Edges are intentionally jagged and irregular, resembling a rough stencil or photocopy
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' is segmented into two distinct halves
The 'F' has an elongated top bar with a distressed terminal
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between aggressive, large-scale display text and clean, functional metadata.
graphicDevices: Internal rectangular frame with rough, hand-drawn edges
Perspective lines from a ribbed tunnel structure
Subtle film grain and noise overlays

preserve: The horizontal slice through the main text
avoid: Clean, modern sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy block skeleton for further distress
Captures the industrial, utilitarian feel of the lettering

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of six young adults in early 2000s urban fashion standing in a perspective-heavy ribbed tunnel. Apply a cold blue color grade and place them inside a rough-edged rectangular frame. Leave the top 25% of the image clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, black, distressed block lettering at the top. Manually apply a horizontal 2px slice through the center of the letters. Add small, clean sans-serif metadata text at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the red jacket the only high-saturation element?
Does the main text have a visible horizontal cut?
Is the internal frame edge irregular and distressed?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color grade
Amount of distress on the typography
Number of figures in the ensemble
mustRedesign: The specific faces of the individuals to avoid likeness issues
Any specific brand logos on the clothing

mustAchieve: Strong sense of depth via tunnel perspective

postGenerationChecks: Check that the horizontal slice in the text is clean and consistent.
Ensure the blue tint doesn't wash out the red accent color.
Verify the internal frame doesn't obscure the subjects' faces.
Confirm the overall texture feels like a physical collage or print.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Ensemble + Tunnel Perspective + [Color: Cold Blue] + [Accent: Crimson] + [Type: Sliced Grunge Block]
